prompt: Objective: grow a winery's sales. What you've learned: restaurant sales fell 12% and online sales rose 30%, and restaurant wine sales are falling across the whole region. Latest finding: online now makes up 40% of sales. What is the best next step?

options.text: Find out why restaurant sales fell
options.feedback: Already answered: restaurant wine sales are falling across the region, not just for this winery. The growth is online.

options.text: Work out how restaurant and online prices compare
options.feedback: Secondary to how to grow where demand is moving.

options.text: Let the interviewer choose which channel to focus on
options.feedback: Drive the case: the finding points online.

options.text: Plan how to win more online customers
options.feedback: Right. Online is the growing channel and 40% of sales, so grow there.

explanation: Restaurant wine sales are falling region-wide, and online is now 40% of sales and growing. Work out how to win more online customers.
